review.notes: Full review. Seeded sample 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1: every statement, Check and example recomputed by exhaustive search (Clos and Slepian-Duguid for small r, n, m; Benes on 2, 4 wires and Waksman settings on 8; butterfly on 2, 4, 8 wires; all sorting networks of lengths 3, 4, 5 on 2, 3, 4 wires) and the routes read by hand. Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; one-tactic probe closes none of the five theorems; two definitions evaluated in Lean against hand values. 14 library declarations opened at the pins; 4 supplier citations resolved on main; dependency check 0 problems; automatic checks all passed. Sources: only the 2015 revision of Lehman-Leighton-Meyer could be read (content supports 2.1 and 2.2; the cited 2018 numbering unchecked); Giaccone's notes and Waksman's abstract not readable from a legal place, listed under Not verifiable and for the human reviewers.
